title: Monthly review
summary: Export, post-mortem, outliers in your own work, experiments, platform changes, calibration, strategy update, next calendar.

steps.title: Export the month
steps.do: Download analytics from each platform you post on.

steps.title: Post-mortem
steps.do: Rank by multiple over your median. Read retention for the top and bottom three.

steps.title: Your own outliers
steps.do: Which hooks, topics and formats beat your median. What did the misses share.

steps.title: Review experiments
steps.do: Read each result with its sample size. Adopt, extend or drop.

steps.title: Check what changed on the platforms
steps.do: Run the stale-facts check. Search for new policy or ranking announcements.

steps.title: Calibrate the hook score
steps.do: With 30+ posts, see which of the six checks predict YOUR winners.

steps.title: Update the strategy
steps.do: Keep, change or cut. Hub, spokes, pillars, cadence.
